# See gross and net revenue retention from the same waterfall.

> Break starting MRR into new, expansion, reactivation, contraction, and churned MRR, then get ending MRR, gross and net revenue retention, and your growth-to-loss quick ratio. Runs entirely in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
